# Vendored libraries

- `viz-global.js`: Viz.js 3.31.0 (https://github.com/mdaines/viz-js), MIT licence.
  Graphviz compiled to WebAssembly. The web IDE uses it to draw diagrams in the browser
  when Graphviz is not installed on the computer, so the Studio works with no install
  and no internet. Graphviz itself is under the Eclipse Public License.
